notes: idle/browsing are real BENIGN ticks; beaconing/bulk_upload/port_scan are real ticks shaped like their matching ATTACK_MIXES entry and are for measurement only, never trained on -- see this module's docstring for why.
bulk_upload/port_scan were captured over loopback (lo0): not a real NIC path (MTU, latency/jitter).
beaconing used a 7s interval, far faster than a realistic C2 cadence, so capture finished in one sitting.
